# EduNest — Implementation Todo

Recreation of ColorLib OneSchool (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/oneschool/)

## Section order (from live preview DOM)

1. Navbar — transparent overlay on hero, logo + nav links (Home, Courses, Programs, Teachers) + Contact Us CTA pill button
2. Hero — background image, "Learn From The Expert" heading, paragraph, "Admission Now" pill CTA, sign-up form (Email, Password, Re-type Password)
3. Courses — title strip in `#7971EA`, carousel of 6 course cards (image, price, lessons/weeks, title, description, students, comments), prev/next buttons
4. Our Programs — centered title + paragraph, 3 alternating rows: illustration left + text/stats right (then flipped), stats: graduates, universities
5. Our Teachers — centered title, 3-column teacher profile cards (image + name)
6. Testimonial — dark overlay bg image, centered quote with author photo (rounded), blockquote text
7. Why Choose Us — centered title, stat cards with icon + label (6 items: graduates, universities, professionals, knowledge, courses, best teachers)
8. Message Us (Contact) — light gray bg, centered title + paragraph, form: First/Last Name, Subject, Email, Message, "Send Message" button
9. Footer — white bg, 3 columns (About EduNest, Links, Subscribe with email), copyright + Component Dock link
